capabilities: Toggle fullscreen mode by double click or touch
Set a triple-click trigger via settings
Restrict triggering to commands and hotkeys to avoid accidental toggles
extras: The README credits Aleksey Rowan for the command/hotkey-only contribution and lists a contact email.
motivation: The author wants more display space when focusing on reading notes, especially on mobile devices.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to quickly toggle fullscreen mode, especially useful on small mobile screens.
summary: Cross-platform fullscreen toggle that hides the app chrome to give more display space for reading notes, via double-click, command, or hotkey.
